note: Day 1 of chunk 1: the masters read by eye at 304 (a grid over each picture, 3 to 5 times enlarged). Every number is in pixels of the 304 x 312 image, read to about +-2 px. Yaws are estimates from the foreshortening of the far eye and of the body. 'exclude' lists the boxes (x0, y0, x1, y1) that the core silhouette leaves out: headgear, tail, wings and antennae (plan 2.6). The annotations are the measurement; calibration.mjs turns them into the table.

masters.name: Loika
masters.notes: Head 105 high, 176 wide on screen: with the face turned 28 degrees a W/H of 1.3 and a depth near H. The nose is the big dark mound between the far eye and the mouth: 35 px wide against an iris of 41.

masters.name: Usvel, the snail
masters.notes: A round head 77 px across on a rise at the front of a body of four soft segments 57 px thick that lies along a foot skirt. No nose can be read: a pale bump at most, between the eyes.

masters.name: Peplos, the bee
masters.notes: The head is the largest mass; the thorax and the abdomen are each about 55 px tall against its 71. Six thin pale legs.

masters.name: the bean
masters.notes: One mass under a mushroom cap, a small face high on the front. The face window is the cluster of eyes and mouth padded by half an iris.

masters.name: Wickle
masters.notes: A pear of clumped fur that narrows into the plume; the cream mask is the face window.

masters.name: Curlop
masters.notes: The head and its mane are one mass of fur: the head runs from the mane at the back to the face, and its lower edge is the cream of the chin.
